CFDA President Apologizes After Altercation with Protesters

Steve Kolb, the president of the Council of Fashion Designers of America (CFDA), has apologized for his actions during a physical altercation with protesters at a New York Fashion Week show. The incident occurred during a fashion show. Kolb stated he acted "inappropriately" and apologized for his behavior. Specific details about the protesters' demands or the exact nature of the altercation were not provided in the coverage.
